<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <PreferenceScreen xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
<PreferenceCategory android:title="Plane Registrations"> <EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="" android:key="airfield_default" android:title="Default airfield." android:summary="Suggested when preparing a log." />
<EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="LN-G" android:key="glider_default_reg" android:title="Default glider registration" android:summary="Suggestion when starting a new flight. Default: LN-G" /> </PreferenceCategory>
<PreferenceCategory android:title="Summing"> <EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="5" android:key="round_sums_to" android:title="Round duration sums to nearest N minutes" android:summary="Only affects summary page. Default: 5" /> </PreferenceCategory>
<PreferenceCategory android:title="Sending Logs"> <EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="" android:key="send_log_email" android:title="Email address to send log to" />
<SwitchPreferenceCompat android:defaultValue="true" android:key="send_log_to_customers" android:title="Send log to pilots" android:summary="If enabled, include pilots with known email addresses." />
<SwitchPreferenceCompat android:defaultValue="true" android:key="send_log_to_customers_using_bcc" android:title="Send using BCC" android:summary="If log is sent to pilots, choose BCC or CC." /> </PreferenceCategory>
<PreferenceCategory android:title="Upload Logs"> <SwitchPreferenceCompat android:defaultValue="false" android:key="upload_log_enabled" android:title="Upload logs to server" android:summary="If enabled, upload logs with HTTP POST." />
<EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="https://" android:key="upload_log_url" android:title="URL for log upload" />
<EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="" android:key="upload_log_username" android:title="HTTP basic auth username" />
<EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="" android:key="upload_log_password" android:title="HTTP basic auth password" /> </PreferenceCategory>
<PreferenceCategory android:title="Fiken.no API"> <SwitchPreferenceCompat android:defaultValue="false" android:key="fiken_api_enabled" android:title="Enable Fiken API usage" android:summary="If enabled, allows loading names and emails from Fiken." />
<EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="https://api.fiken.no/api/v2/companies/<companyname>/contacts" android:key="fiken_api_url" android:title="Fiken URL to Contact REST API" />
<EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="" android:key="fiken_api_password" android:title="Fiken API bearer key" /> </PreferenceCategory>
<PreferenceCategory android:title="Notes"> <EditTextPreference android:defaultValue="Instruktoropplaering,Introkurs,Klubbslep" android:key="default_notes" android:title="Default notes" android:summary="Comma-separated list of default autocomplete notes available." /> </PreferenceCategory>
</PreferenceScreen>
